decision_universe.definition: all completed PASS regular-session M15 candles per market, independent of prior model score or BUY/SELL/HOLD decision
decision_universe.decision_time: no earlier than both M15 completion UTC and its observed ingestion/availability UTC; missing availability makes the feature snapshot UNVERIFIABLE
decision_universe.execution_source: completed PASS IG_LIGHTSTREAMER M1 bid/ask only
decision_universe.unverifiable_policy: missing or invalid broker M1, post-decision or missing feature availability, source transition, intrabar ambiguity, or unknown cost never becomes a loss, profit or NO_TRADE label

policy_selection.rule: choose at most one policy family per market using development data only; report all pre-registered families, including losing and unverifiable cohorts
policy_selection.market_or_session_close: exit at last complete executable regular-session M1 close if declared; otherwise UNVERIFIABLE
policy_selection.minimum_stop_distance: must satisfy current authoritative IG rule; otherwise broker eligibility remains blocked

cost_policy.spread: executable bid/ask entry and exit in each complete IG M1 path
cost_policy.slippage_normal: 0.25 times that market's development-only 75th-percentile IG M1 close spread bps, per side; sensitivity assumption, not an observed fill
cost_policy.slippage_stressed: 1.0 times that market's development-only 95th-percentile IG M1 close spread bps, per side; sensitivity assumption, not an observed fill
cost_policy.commission: use instrument/account-specific broker contract evidence; unknown yields UNVERIFIABLE net result
cost_policy.financing: charge only at a broker-authoritative rollover crossing; unknown rollover/rate yields UNVERIFIABLE if holding crosses it
cost_policy.minimum_deal_size_margin_size_increment: record authoritative market/account dealing rules separately from per-unit research return; non-authoritative increment blocks order eligibility
cost_policy.gross_net: report gross executable return before explicit CFD fees and net after all declared costs; never fabricate an exact stop/target exit-mid spread decomposition
cost_policy.positive_claim: PF > 1 and net expectancy > 0 on identical immutable cohort with authoritative or conservative upper-bound cost evidence, chronological validation and untouched holdout

chronology.boundary_change_policy: a changed boundary requires a new protocol version before accessing that partition

cohort_gate.recorded_market_decision_path_inventory: coverage evidence only; old-model BUY/SELL/HOLD selection cannot define a new training universe
cohort_gate.model_training_now: BLOCKED until complete M15 decision universe, IG M1 paths, cost authority and immutable cohort exist
cohort_gate.shadow_evidence: prospective only, after a governed candidate
